criteria.text: `GET /api/tone` with no query params returns HTTP 200 and a body with exactly the keys `persons`, `domains`, `cells`.
`days` missing or non-numeric defaults to 30; values are clamped to [1, 365].

`min` missing or non-numeric defaults to 3; values are clamped to [1, 1000]; this default and clamp are independent of `GraphQuery.min`'s default of 2 (verified by a test that does not touch `parseQuery`/`GraphQuery`).
`persons` contains every row from the `persons` table, ordered by name, shaped `{ id, name }`, with no `aliases` field.
A `(person, domain)` pair with fewer toned docs than `min` in the window produces **no** entry in `cells` (not an entry with `n < min`).

A `(person, domain)` pair with toned-doc count `>= min` produces exactly one `cells` entry whose `tone` (rounded to 2 decimals) and `n` match a hand-computed average over the fixture's docs for that pair.
A person with zero toned docs across all domains appears in `persons` and has zero entries in `cells`.
A doc with `domain` unset never causes a `null`/empty-string entry in `domains`, even when its tone would otherwise clear `min` on its own.
Lowering `min` (e.g. to 2) surfaces at least one pair that was absent at the default `min=3`, using the fixture.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` both pass, including the new tone tests.
Manual: in `public/design-5.html`, toggling to "tom por veículo" replaces the atlas view with the heat table without a full page reload, and the "tom só existe em textos do GDELT" note is visible.
Manual: hovering a filled cell shows its `n` in a tooltip; a cell with no data shows a dash, is not colored, and is not clickable.
Manual: switching back to "atlas" shows the same person and filters that were selected before switching to the tone view.
